title: Mato Grosso campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Mato Grosso campaign", at revision 1379802413, opens: "The Mato Grosso campaign was an early Paraguayan offensive in the Paraguayan War. Paraguay invaded the Brazilian province of Mato Grosso. Paraguay captured part of the Brazilian province of Mato Grosso, but it was a pyrrhic victory, since they obtained little gain in it." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2005365, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 first phase of the War of the Triple Alliance". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
